title: C++: TCP Server (Simulated)
description: Simulate a TCP server that accepts connections and echoes messages.

steps.title: Echo Server Simulation
steps.description: Create a simulated TCP server using queues. Define a Connection struct with id and message queue. Write a server that accepts connections, receives messages, and echoes them back. Simulate 2 clients sending messages.
hints: Use queues to simulate network buffers.
Server receives, prints, and echoes back.
